prompt: Camel netty-http unix-domain-socket-path required settings constraints
answer:
For Camel `netty-http` with `unix-domain-socket-path`:

- Set `unix-domain-socket-path` to the Unix domain socket path.
- Set `nativeTransport=true`.
- Set `clientMode=false`.
- `host` and `port` are still required by the endpoint syntax, but they are ignored; dummy values are acceptable.

Source: [Camel Spring Boot Netty HTTP documentation](https://github.com/apache/camel-spring-boot/blob/f3c57cca2cc07e0a10e3962cb42ae0addbcfb6fa/docs/spring-boot/modules/ROOT/pages/starters/netty-http.adoc).
